related_resources.reason: Hypothesis tests, p-values, rejection regions and their interpretations.
Type-II error, power and hypothesis-test design.
Guidance on the interpretation and limitations of p-values.

authorship.scope: Original statistical-inference foundation lecture and non-spoken mathematical companion; earlier manuscripts preserved.

prerequisites.reason: Elementary probability and estimation material from 020000.
Elementary probability and estimation material from 021000.

background: Elementary probability, fractions, logarithms and basic calculus. No measure theory, asymptotic statistics or Bayesian analysis required.
readiness_checks: Calculate exact one-sided and two-sided binomial p-values for eight successes in ten trials.
Distinguish type-I error, power, effect size, and the meaning of a p-value.
Enumerate a four-unit randomization test and articulate its assignment assumption.
